entities.summary: Tsimafei Zhukouski is a Croatian professional volleyball player who plays as a setter for the Croatia national team. As a player of Mladost Zagreb, he has won the Croatian Championship in 2007, 2008 and 2010, as well as two national cups in 2008 and 2009.
